items.markdown:
![THE 15 BEST Things to Do in Pai (2026) - Must-See Attractions](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07270019-1672-0139-0000-b4955d4ac255:4)
Top things to do in Pai include watching the sunset at [Pai Canyon](https://www.thelostpassport.com/pai-thailand-guide/) , relaxing in natural hot springs, and exploring local night markets . This bohemian mountain town in northern Thailand offers a great mix of outdoor adventure and laid-back village vibes.[](https://www.tripadvisor.co.uk/Attractions-g303916-Activities-Pai_Mae_Hong_Son_Province.html) [[1]](https://www.tripadvisor.co.uk/Attractions-g303916-Activities-Pai_Mae_Hong_Son_Province.html)[[2]](https://www.thelostpassport.com/pai-thailand-guide/)[[3]](https://inbetweentravels.com/pai-travel-guide-thailand/)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/ksVJ7kqmMpA)[[5]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5N9QGqrL_w0&t=36)

Nature and Views

- **Pai Canyon (Kong Lan):** Walk narrow dirt ridges above the trees and watch the sunset (arrive by 4:30 PM for a good spot; wear sturdy shoes).
- **Pam Bok and Mo Paeng Waterfalls:** Swim in cool mountain water or slide down natural rock formations.
- **Pam Bok / Boon Ko Ku So Bamboo Bridge:** Stroll along a peaceful one-kilometer wooden walkway stretching over green rice paddies.
- **Yun Lai Viewpoint:** Head up early in the morning for sweeping views over the misty valleys near the Chinese village.[](https://www.skyetravels.com/guide-to-pai/) [[1]](https://www.skyetravels.com/guide-to-pai/)[[2]](https://lewildexplorer.com/the-9-best-things-to-do-in-pai-thailand/)[[3]](https://theroamingrenegades.com/things-to-do-in-pai-thailand/)[[4]](https://www.tiktok.com/@lizeandtom/video/7588951240617331990)

Relaxation and Culture

- **Sai Ngam and Tha Pai Hot Springs:** Soak in crystal-clear, tree-lined mineral pools with warm, natural spring water.
- **Wat Phra That Mae Yen (White Buddha):** Climb the stairs up the hillside for panoramic town views and a quiet sunset spot.
- **Santichon Village:** Visit the Chinese-Yuncan cultural settlement to try local teas and traditional food.[](https://inbetweentravels.com/pai-travel-guide-thailand/) 

Food and Town Life

- **Pai Walking Street:** Browse local crafts, clothing, and cheap street food stalls every evening from 5:00 PM onward.
- **Cafe Hopping:** Relax in quirky, rustic coffee shops scattered throughout the town and surrounding countryside.
- **Live Music Bars:** Listen to acoustic sets and enjoy cheap drinks at laid-back spots like *Jazz House*.[](https://www.tripadvisor.co.uk/Attractions-g303916-Activities-Pai_Mae_Hong_Son_Province.html) [[1]](https://jonistravelling.com/best-things-to-do-in-pai-thailand/)
